counterexample.description: Encode a cancellation incorrectly as an ordinary same-card ASSOCATION_PENDING update. The current coalescing rule should absorb it, add a semantic revision, and fail to mark the notice cancelled; this demonstrates why cancellation needs an explicit protected action kind.
